definition_zh: 柔软的；轻盈灵活的
definition_en: able to bend and move easily and gracefully
core_image: 舞者屈膝侧弯，身体像柳条一样顺势弯过去
scene: 体操馆里，一名舞者侧身下腰，身体像柳条一样舒展开来。In the gym, the lithe dancer bent low to one side with a smooth, steady motion.
sceneCN: 这里 lithe 是「柔软而轻盈的」（第 01 个义项：身体柔韧、动作舒展灵活）；句意：体操馆里，一名舞者侧身下腰，身体像柳条一样舒展开来。

pos.zh: 柔软的；轻盈的；灵活敏捷的

derivatives.zh: lithe 加名词后缀 -ness，义为「柔软；轻盈灵活」
lithe 加形容词后缀 -some，义为「柔顺灵巧的」，多见于文学描写

senses.title: Bending and moving with ease
senses.definition: thin, supple, and able to move in a smooth and graceful way
senses.definitionCN: 身形纤细、柔韧，动作流畅而优美
senses.example: The lithe girl climbed the rock face without effort.
senses.exampleCN: 那个身手轻巧的女孩毫不费力地爬上了岩壁。
senses.why: The Old English word first meant gentle and mild, and the picture of something that yields without snapping grew into supple ease of movement.
senses.whyCN: 古英语中这个词本义是「温和柔顺」，柔软的物体容易弯折而不折断，这一画面后来发展成身体柔韧、动作轻巧。

senses.title: Agile in thought or manner
senses.titleCN: （言谈举止）灵巧的；灵活机敏的
senses.definition: showing quick and easy grace in speech, bearing, or behaviour
senses.definitionCN: 在言语、身姿或行为上显得轻快灵动、不呆板
senses.example: Her lithe wit carried the conversation forward.
senses.exampleCN: 她机敏的谈吐让谈话一路顺畅。
senses.why: Body movement is the source: a mind or a manner that bends quickly is pictured as just as lithe.
senses.whyCN: 身体动作是源头：脑子和举止能迅速转弯，就被想象得同样轻盈。

senses.title: Slender and springy in shape
senses.titleCN: （草木、枝条）柔韧的；细长轻盈的
senses.definition: long, thin, and easily bent back, as of stems or branches
senses.definitionCN: 细长而容易弯回，常用于形容茎干或枝条
senses.example: A lithe willow branch brushed the surface of the water.
senses.exampleCN: 一根细柔的柳枝拂过水面。
senses.why: The gentle, yielding sense fits plants best, which is why country writers applied the word to slender stems.
senses.whyCN: 「温和顺从」的本义最适合植物，所以乡野作家把这个词用在了细长的枝条上。

intro.en: Lithe goes back to Old English lithe, gentle or mild, and is related to the old sense of something soft and easily bent.
intro.cn: lithe 源于古英语 lithe（温和、柔顺），与其早期「柔软易弯」之义同出一脉。

items.en: The root is usually reconstructed as leydh, meaning to bend.
items.cn: 一般认为其词根可重构为 leydh，意为「弯曲」。

items.en: Lithe means gentle, mild, or kind.
items.cn: 古英语 lithe 意为温和、柔顺、仁慈。

items.en: The sense of soft and pliable grows beside the older sense of mild.
items.cn: 中古英语中，「柔软可弯」的义项与原有的「温和」义并存生长。

items.en: The word comes to describe supple, graceful bodies.
items.cn: 十六世纪起，这个词用来形容柔韧而优美的身形。

items.en: Poets and novelists give it to branches, deer, and dancers.
items.cn: 十九世纪的诗人与小说家把它用在枝条、鹿和舞者身上。

items.en: Modern English keeps lithe mostly for graceful, flexible movement.
items.cn: 现代英语主要用 lithe 形容优雅灵活的动作。

note.en: Lithe has look-alikes such as lathe and lithograph, and sits close to supple, graceful, and agile.
note.cn: lithe 有形近词 lathe 与 lithograph，义场上紧挨 supple、graceful 与 agile。

entries.definition: a machine that turns wood or metal
entries.definitionCN: 车床；只是拼写与读音都接近，词源不同

entries.definition: a print made from a stone surface

entries.definitionCN: light 的商业拼写，指低脂、轻量的；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: able to bend easily without breaking
entries.definitionCN: 柔软的；柔韧易弯的

entries.definition: moving smoothly and attractively
entries.definitionCN: 优雅的；动作优美的

entries.definition: able to move quickly and easily
entries.definitionCN: 敏捷的；灵巧的

normalIntro.en: Lithe carries an old gentle root: what yields without breaking looks light and graceful.
normalIntro.cn: lithe 带有一层古老的「柔顺」底色：能弯而不折的东西，看上去就轻盈优美。

normal.en: A lithe figure is slim, supple, and easy in motion.
normal.cn: lithe figure 指身形纤细、柔韧、动作轻快。

normal.en: Lithe and graceful often appear together to describe dancers.
normal.cn: lithe and graceful 常连用来描写舞者。

normal.en: The noun litheness keeps the same soft and bendable image.
normal.cn: 名词 litheness 保留同样的「柔软可弯」意象。

normal.en: Compare flexible: flexible can describe metal or plans, lithe usually describes living bodies.
normal.cn: 对比 flexible：flexible 可形容金属或计划，lithe 通常形容活的身体。

normal.en: The old adjective meant gentle, which prepares the modern sense of easy, yielding motion.
normal.cn: 这个词的古义是「温和」，正好过渡到现代「舒展、不生硬的动作」。

abstract.en: Picture a dancer bending to one side like a young willow.
abstract.cn: 想象一名舞者像嫩柳一样向一侧弯下腰。

abstract.en: Think of a slim branch that springs back the moment you let it go.
abstract.cn: 想象一根细枝，一松手就立刻弹回原样。

abstract.en: Hold the sound of lithe beside the word slide to hear the smooth movement.
abstract.cn: 把 lithe 的读音与 slide 放在一起，就能听出那种顺滑的动作感。

examples.en: The dancer was tall and lithe, and her turns were perfectly smooth.
examples.cn: 那位舞者身材高挑、动作柔韧，转身极其流畅。

examples.en: A lithe cat leapt from the table to the shelf.
examples.cn: 一只轻捷的猫从桌上跃到架子上。

examples.en: Bringing up a family keeps women lithe in the arts of patience and planning.
examples.cn: 操持家庭让女性在耐心与筹划上一直保持灵活。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「赖得」——小孩赖在床上，身体又软又灵活，翻来滚去；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 lithe（温和、柔顺）→ 中古英语「柔软可弯」→ 现代英语「柔软、轻巧、灵活」，核心义一直是「不硬、能顺势而弯」。

sensesIntro.en: Lithe grows from a gentle, yielding image into supple bodies, then flexible minds, and finally slender, bendable stems.
sensesIntro.cn: lithe 从「温和顺从」的画面长出柔韧的身体，再延伸到机敏的心智，最后落到细长可弯的枝条。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body that bends like a young branch, then springs back without effort.
core.cn: 核心意象：身体像嫩枝一样顺势弯下，又毫不费力地弹回。

branches.en: The supple, graceful body is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 柔韧优美的身体是日常的核心义项。

branches.en: A quick, flexible mind borrows the physical image.
branches.cn: 机敏灵活的心智借用了这一身体意象。

branches.en: Plants give the oldest picture of bending without breaking.
branches.cn: 草木提供了「弯而不断」最古老的画面。

branches.en: A lithe branch and a lithe dancer share the same springy line.
branches.cn: 柔韧的枝条与灵巧的舞者共享同一种有弹性的线条。

branches.en: All three senses keep the gentle, yielding core.
branches.cn: 三个义项都保留了「温和、顺势」的内核。

intro.en: Lithe is a plain Old English adjective, and English builds litheness and lithesome on it.
intro.cn: lithe 是纯古英语形容词，英语在它基础上构成了 litheness 与 lithesome。

latinIntro.en: Lithe has no Latin source; it is an inherited Old English word, so there are no Latin cognates to list.
latinIntro.cn: lithe 没有拉丁语来源，是古英语继承下来的词，因此没有拉丁同源词可列。

items.example: Old texts used lithe for a mild temper.
items.exampleCN: 古文献用 lithe 形容脾气温和。

items.example: Modern lithe describes a flexible body.
items.exampleCN: 现代 lithe 形容柔软灵活的身形。

items.example: The suffix -ness forms litheness.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ness 构成 litheness。

items.example: Litheness names the quality itself.
items.exampleCN: litheness 指这种柔韧的特质。

items.example: The suffix -some forms lithesome.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -some 构成 lithesome。

items.example: Lithesome is the literary variant.
items.exampleCN: lithesome 是偏文学色彩的变体。

items.example: Lithely adds the regular adverb suffix -ly.
items.exampleCN: lithely 由常规副词后缀 -ly 构成。

items.example: Supple is the nearest everyday partner.
items.exampleCN: supple 是最贴近的日常近义词。

definition_zh: 石生的；由岩石构成或形成的
definition_en: living on or among rocks, or formed from rock
core_image: 紧贴岩壁的一层小珊瑚，本身就是石头长出来的
scene: 浅海考察中，队员发现珊瑚虫一簇簇长在岩石上。On the shallow dive, the team found lithogenous corals growing in clusters on stone.
sceneCN: 这里 lithogenous 是「石生的」（第 01 个义项：生长在岩石上）；句意：浅海考察中，队员发现石生珊瑚一簇簇长在岩石上。

pos.zh: 石生的；岩石生成的；由岩石构成的

collocations.zh: 岩质沉积物；由岩石来源物质形成的沉积
岩质材料；由岩石来源的物质

derivatives.zh: litho-（石）+ -gen（生成者），指构成母岩或岩质的物质
-genous 换成名词后缀 -genesis（生成），义为「岩石形成过程」
litho- + -logy（学科），义为「岩性学」，描述岩石的组成与性质

senses.title: Living on rock
senses.definition: living on, in, or attached to rocks, as certain corals, sponges, and algae
senses.definitionCN: 生在岩石上、岩石间或附着在岩石上，如某些珊瑚、海绵和藻类
senses.example: Lithogenous corals build a thin crust on the cliff face.
senses.exampleCN: 石生珊瑚在崖壁上长出一层薄薄的硬壳。
senses.why: The Greek first part means stone, and the second means born, so the compound reads as born of stone.
senses.whyCN: 构词前半来自希腊语「石」，后半意为「生出」，合起来就是「从石头里生出来的」。

senses.title: Formed from rock material
senses.titleCN: 由岩石物质形成的；岩质的
senses.definition: produced from rocky material or made of fragments of rock
senses.definitionCN: 由岩石来源的物质产生，或由岩屑构成的
senses.example: The geologist dated the lithogenous layers near the river.
senses.exampleCN: 地质学家测定了河边的岩质地层年代。
senses.why: The same born of stone image is opened to matter, so the adjective can cover whole layers of sediment.
senses.whyCN: 把「生于石」解读成「由石质生成」，这个词就能形容整层沉积物。

senses.title: Rock forming, chiefly in compounds
senses.definition: used in scientific compounds to mean rock producing
senses.definitionCN: 在科学复合词中表示「生成岩石的」
senses.example: The report lists several lithogenous processes along the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 报告列出了沿海地区的几种成岩过程。
senses.why: The suffix names only birth or production, so technical writers bend the word towards making rock as a process.
senses.whyCN: 后缀只说「生成」，并不限定生成什么，于是技术写作者顺势把它扩展到「造成岩石」的过程上。

intro.en: Lithogenous is a scientific compound made of Greek elements in English, not an inherited word.
intro.cn: lithogenous 是英语中用希腊语词素拼成的新造术语，不是传承词。

items.en: Lithos means a stone.
items.cn: 希腊语 lithos 意为石头。

items.en: The element -genes means born or produced.
items.cn: 词素 -genes 意为「生出的、产生的」。

items.en: Scientific Latin borrows both elements for new coinages.
items.cn: 科学拉丁语借用这两个词素来造新词。

items.en: Naturalists coin litho- compounds as geology grows.
items.cn: 十九世纪地质学兴起，博物学者用 litho- 拼出大批复合词。

items.en: Lithogenous enters geology and biology for rock-living and rock-formed things.
items.cn: 十九到二十世纪，lithogenous 进入地质学与生物学，指「石生」与「岩质」。

items.en: Modern English uses it mostly in scientific prose about reefs, deposits, and organism habitats.
items.cn: 现代英语主要在关于礁体、沉积与生物栖息的科学文章中使用。

note.en: Lithogenous is a compound of litho- and -genous, and sits beside rock-setting words such as lithic, terrigenous, and biogenic.
note.cn: lithogenous 由 litho- 与 -genous 合成，义场紧邻 lithic、terrigenous 与 biogenic 等描述岩石来源的词。

entries.definition: the study of the make-up of rocks
entries.definitionCN: 岩性学；同用 litho- 前缀

entries.definition: a plant growing on rock
entries.definitionCN: 石生植物；同用 litho- 前缀，与「石生」义最贴近

entries.definition: made of parts of the same kind
entries.definitionCN: 同质的；与 -genous 后缀相同，但词根不同

entries.definition: made of stone
entries.definitionCN: 石质的；由石头构成的

entries.definition: coming from land, as sediment
entries.definitionCN: 陆源的（沉积物来自陆地）

entries.definition: produced by living things
entries.definitionCN: 生物成因的；由生物产生的

normalIntro.en: Lithogenous is a transparent Greek compound: stone plus born.
normalIntro.cn: lithogenous 是一个一看就懂的希腊语复合词：石头加「生出」。

normal.en: The prefix litho- marks stone, as in lithograph and lithology.
normal.cn: 前缀 litho- 表示石，见 lithograph 与 lithology。

normal.en: The suffix -genous means born or produced, as in biogenous.
normal.cn: 后缀 -genous 表示「生出的」，见 biogenous。

normal.en: Lithogenous coral lives glued to rock rather than on sand.
normal.cn: lithogenous coral 指贴着岩石生长而非长在沙地的珊瑚。

normal.en: Terrigenous sediment comes from land, while lithogenous material echoes the rock it came from.
normal.cn: terrigenous 指陆源沉积，而 lithogenous 强调物质来自岩石本身。

normal.en: Compare lithic: lithic describes the material, lithogenous describes where it came from.
normal.cn: 对比 lithic：lithic 说材料是石，lithogenous 说来源是石。

abstract.en: Picture a thin line of coral gripping a wet cliff at low tide.
abstract.cn: 想象退潮时，一条薄薄的珊瑚紧紧贴着湿崖壁。

abstract.en: Picture a sieve catching gravel, and each grain still carrying the mountain it broke off.
abstract.cn: 想像筛子里接住的砂砾，每一粒还带着它脱落的那座山。

abstract.en: Hear the two halves, stone and born, click together like two Lego bricks.
abstract.cn: 把「石」与「生」两半像乐高积木一样扣在一起。

examples.en: The survey mapped lithogenous communities along the reef wall.
examples.cn: 这次调查测绘了礁壁上的石生生物群落。

examples.en: Thick layers of lithogenous sediment buried the old bay.
examples.cn: 厚厚的岩质沉积层盖住了旧海湾。

examples.en: Lithogenous algae often look like dark stains on wet cliffs.
examples.cn: 石生藻类常常看起来像湿崖壁上的深色污渍。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「立时出石」——立时从石里长出来，正是「石生的」；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 lithos（石）+ -genes（生出的）+ 英语形容词后缀 -ous → 科学拉丁语 → 英语 lithogenous，核心义「生于石、由石生成」。

sensesIntro.en: Lithogenous starts with things born on stone, widens to material formed from rock, and is stretched to rock-producing processes in technical prose.
sensesIntro.cn: lithogenous 先指生在石上的东西，再扩展到由岩石物质形成之物，最后在科技文章中延伸到成岩过程。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin living crust gripping wet stone, and grains that still carry their parent rock.
core.cn: 核心意象：紧贴湿石的薄薄活壳，以及仍带着母岩的砂粒。

branches.en: Life attached to rock is the biological sense.
branches.cn: 附着在岩石上的生命是生物学义项。

branches.en: Material born from rock is the geological sense.
branches.cn: 由岩石物质生成的材料是地质学义项。

branches.en: Rock-producing processes stretch the word in compounds.
branches.cn: 成岩过程在复合词中进一步拉伸这个词的用法。

branches.en: Corals both live on stone and build stone.
branches.cn: 珊瑚既长在石上，又自行造石，两个义项在礁体处交汇。

branches.en: All three senses keep stone as their source or setting.
branches.cn: 三个义项都以「石」为来源或场所。

intro.en: Lithogenous is built from three pieces of Greek origin, which lets scientific English coin new words freely.
intro.cn: lithogenous 由三个源出希腊语的部分组成，这正是科技英语能随意造新词的原因。

latinIntro.en: The parts come from Greek, and Latin only serves as the scientific channel; lapis, the Latin noun for stone, is a separate word.
latinIntro.cn: 这些词素来自希腊语，拉丁语只充当科学传播的渠道；拉丁语表示石头的 lapis 属于另一个词。

items.example: The form litho- comes from Greek lithos.
items.exampleCN: litho- 源自希腊语 lithos。

items.example: The element -genes supplies the born part.
items.exampleCN: 词素 -genes 提供「生出」这一部分。

items.example: The suffix -genous joins it to English.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -genous 把它接进英语。

items.example: Lithogenous keeps the full compound.
items.exampleCN: lithogenous 保留了完整的复合结构。

items.example: Lithology shares the stone prefix.
items.exampleCN: lithology 共享「石」前缀。

items.meaning: a print from a stone surface
items.example: Lithograph shows the printing history of the prefix.
items.exampleCN: lithograph 展示了该前缀在印刷史中的用法。

items.example: Lithophyte swaps the born element for a plant element.
items.exampleCN: lithophyte 把「生」换成「植物」。

items.example: The ending -ous turns the compound into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ous 把复合词变成形容词。

items.example: Biogenous shares the born suffix with a life prefix.
items.exampleCN: biogenous 用「生命」前缀配同样的后缀。

definition_zh: 垃圾；杂物；乱丢；(动物)一窝幼崽；猫砂；担架
definition_en: small pieces of rubbish left in a public place, or a group of young animals born together
core_image: 草坡上散落的纸杯和塑料袋，东一件西一件
scene: 公园的长椅旁散着几只纸杯和空包装袋，管理员弯腰一个个捡起。Beside the park bench lay several paper cups and empty packets, and the keeper picked up the litter one by one.
sceneCN: 这里 litter 是「散落的垃圾」（第 1 个义项：公共场合乱丢的零星废弃物）；句意：公园长椅旁散着几只纸杯和空包装袋，管理员把它们逐个捡起。

pos.zh: 垃圾；杂物；一窝幼崽；猫砂；担架
乱丢；使凌乱
乱扔垃圾

derivatives.zh: litter 加 bug 构成，指在公共场所乱丢垃圾的人，义为「随地扔垃圾者」
动词 litter 加 -ing 名词化，义为「乱丢垃圾」
litter 加 picker 构成，义为「拾捡垃圾的人」

senses.title: Rubbish dropped in public places
senses.titleCN: 乱丢的垃圾；散落的废弃物
senses.definition: small pieces of rubbish left lying in an open or public place
senses.definitionCN: 留在公共场所地上的零星垃圾
senses.example: The beach was covered in litter after the holiday.
senses.exampleCN: 假期过后，海滩上到处都是垃圾。
senses.why: The medieval sense is bedding straw, so litter is first something scattered loosely on the ground.
senses.whyCN: 中古英语义为铺在床上的稻草，所以 litter 最初指松散地撒在地上的东西。

senses.title: A group of young animals
senses.definition: a group of young animals born to one mother at one time
senses.definitionCN: 同一只母兽一次产下的一群幼崽
senses.example: The cat gave birth to a litter of four kittens.
senses.exampleCN: 这只猫一窝生下了四只小猫。
senses.why: A draught animal lay on straw bedding, and its young were born on that bedding, the litter.
senses.whyCN: 家畜躺在草铺上生产，幼崽就诞生在那层铺草 litter 上，于是这个词也指「一窝幼崽」。

senses.title: A bed of straw for animals
senses.definition: straw or other dry material used as bedding for animals
senses.definitionCN: 给动物铺设当床的稻草或其他干草
senses.example: The farmer spread fresh litter in the stable.
senses.exampleCN: 农民在马厩里铺上了新草。
senses.why: The earliest English sense is straw spread for a bed, and that bedding sense still lives on farms.
senses.whyCN: 英语最早的含义就是铺开当床的稻草，这个「铺草」义项至今仍保存在农场的用法里。

senses.title: To drop rubbish
senses.definition: to throw rubbish on the ground instead of putting it in a bin
senses.definitionCN: 把垃圾扔在地上而不是丢进垃圾箱
senses.example: Visitors who litter in the forest face heavy fines.
senses.exampleCN: 在森林里乱扔垃圾的游客会被重罚。
senses.why: If litter is rubbish scattered on the ground, to litter is the act of scattering it.
senses.whyCN: 如果 litter 是散在地上的垃圾，那么 to litter 就是洒落垃圾这个动作。

senses.title: Carelessly scattered over a surface
senses.definition: to cover a place with many loose objects
senses.definitionCN: 使某个地方满地散落着松散的东西
senses.example: Toys littered the floor of the nursery.
senses.exampleCN: 育婴室的地板上散落着玩具。
senses.why: The scattering image widened from straw and rubbish to any loose objects lying about.
senses.whyCN: 这种「散落」的意象从稻草和垃圾扩展到任何散放着的松散物品。

senses.title: Absorbent material for cats
senses.definition: material sold in bags for cats to use as a toilet
senses.definitionCN: 成袋出售、供猫如厕使用的吸附性材料
senses.example: She cleans the cat litter every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天早上清理猫砂。
senses.why: The bedding sense survives in cat litter, which is dry material spread for an animal to use.
senses.whyCN: 「铺草」义项保存在 cat litter 里，它就是铺在地上供动物使用的干燥材料。

senses.title: A stretcher for carrying the injured
senses.definition: a frame with a cover on which a sick or injured person is carried
senses.definitionCN: 铺有布面、用来抬运伤病者的框架
senses.example: Two officers carried him to the ambulance on a litter.
senses.exampleCN: 两名警官用担架把他抬上了救护车。
senses.why: English took this sense through French from Latin lectus, a bed, so a litter is a portable bed.
senses.whyCN: 英语经法语借自拉丁语 lectus（床），所以担架其实就是一张可以抬着走的床。

senses.title: Junk piled on a surface
senses.definition: a collection of unimportant things lying about untidily
senses.definitionCN: 随意散放的一堆无足轻重的东西
senses.example: Papers and old magazines littered his desk.
senses.exampleCN: 他的书桌上散落着纸张和旧杂志。
senses.why: The core idea of things scattered with no order stretches from street rubbish to untidy personal junk.
senses.whyCN: 「无序散落的东西」这一核心意象从街头垃圾延伸到个人的杂乱物品。

intro.en: Litter goes back through Old French to Latin lectus, a bed, and first meant straw spread as bedding.
intro.cn: litter 经古法语上溯到拉丁语 lectus（床），最初指铺开当床的稻草。

items.en: Lectus means a bed or couch, from the verb legere, to gather or pick.
items.cn: lectus 意为床或卧榻，来自动词 legere（收集、拣取）。

items.en: Lit(i)ere reaches English from Old French, carrying the sense of a bed.
items.cn: lit(i)ere 从古法语进入英语，带有「床」的含义。

items.en: Litter names straw spread under people or animals, and later a portable bed or stretcher.
items.cn: litter 指铺在人畜身下的稻草，后来又指可抬动的床或担架。

items.en: It widens to scattered odds and ends and the young born in one birth.
items.cn: 词义扩展为散放的杂物以及一次产下的一窝幼崽。

items.en: From the nineteenth century litter mainly means rubbish dropped in public places.
items.cn: 从十九世纪起，litter 主要指扔在公共场所的垃圾。

note.en: Litter is French and Latin in origin, close in spelling to little and letter, and close in meaning to rubbish, trash, and refuse.
note.cn: litter 源自法语和拉丁语，拼写上接近 little 和 letter，意义上接近 rubbish、trash 与 refuse。

entries.definition: small in size
entries.definitionCN: 小的；少的（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: a written message, or a symbol of the alphabet
entries.definitionCN: 信；字母（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: covered with scattered rubbish
entries.definitionCN: 铺满散落垃圾的

entries.definition: waste material or things that are no longer wanted
entries.definitionCN: 垃圾；废物

entries.definition: things thrown away, especially in American English
entries.definitionCN: 垃圾；废弃物（尤用于美式英语）

entries.definition: waste material that is to be thrown away
entries.definitionCN: 废弃物（正式用语）

normalIntro.en: Litter began as straw for a bed, and straw spread loose is exactly what scattered rubbish looks like.
normalIntro.cn: litter 最初指铺床的稻草，而松散撒开的稻草，正是散落垃圾的样子。

normal.en: To drop litter is a common warning on British signs.
normal.cn: drop litter 是英国告示上常见的警示语。

normal.en: A litter bin in Britain is what Americans call a trash can.
normal.cn: 英国的 litter bin 相当于美式英语的 trash can。

normal.en: Cat litter keeps a cat toilet tidy.
normal.cn: cat litter 就是保持猫厕所清洁的猫砂。

normal.en: A litter of kittens means several kittens born together.
normal.cn: a litter of kittens 指同一窝生下的小猫。

normal.en: Be littered with means full of or scattered with something.
normal.cn: be littered with 表示「散落着、充满」某物。

abstract.en: Picture straw tossed loosely on a stable floor.
abstract.cn: 想象一把稻草松散地撒在马厩的地上。

abstract.en: Picture a mother cat with four kittens on that straw.
abstract.cn: 想象一只母猫和四只小猫待在那层稻草上。

abstract.en: Picture a park lawn dotted with white cups after a picnic.
abstract.cn: 想象野餐后的公园草坪上点点落着白纸杯。

examples.en: Please put your litter in the bin.
examples.cn: 请把垃圾放进垃圾箱。

examples.en: The street was littered with fallen leaves after the storm.
examples.cn: 暴风雨过后，街道上散落着落叶。

examples.en: Their dog produced a litter of three healthy puppies.
examples.cn: 他们的狗产下了一窝三只健康的小狗。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读音「里特」——公园「里」「特」别脏，满地是纸屑，就是散落的垃圾；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 legere（收集、拣取）→ lectus（床）→ 古法语 lit(i)ere → 英语 litter：从「铺床的稻草」到「一窝幼崽」，再到「散落地上的垃圾」。

sensesIntro.en: Litter starts as straw bedding, then a group of young born on it, then rubbish scattered like straw on the ground.
sensesIntro.cn: litter 先指铺床的稻草，再指在草上产下的一窝幼崽，最后指像稻草一样撒落在地上的垃圾。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: cups and packets scattered loosely on a grassy slope.
core.cn: 核心意象：草坡上东一件西一件散落的纸杯和包装袋。

branches.en: Dropped rubbish is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 随手丢下的垃圾是日常义项。

branches.en: A group of young born together is the animal sense.
branches.cn: 一次生下的一群幼崽是动物义项。

branches.en: Straw bedding is the oldest and most literal sense.
branches.cn: 铺草垫料是最古老、最字面的义项。

branches.en: The act of dropping rubbish and any careless scattering share one motion.
branches.cn: 乱丢垃圾与随手撒落散放，共享同一个动作意象。

branches.en: Cat litter is bedding, and a stretcher is a portable bed.
branches.cn: 猫砂是铺垫物，担架则是一张可以抬走的床。

intro.en: Litter is a whole borrowing from Old French rather than a compound, but English builds litterbug, littering, and litter-picker on it.
intro.cn: litter 是从古法语整体借入的词而非复合词，不过英语围绕它构成了 litterbug、littering 与 litter-picker。

latinIntro.en: Latin lectus means a bed or couch, from legere, to gather or pick.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 lectus 意为床或卧榻，来自 legere（收集、拣取）。

items.example: Lectus is the Latin source of the bedding sense.
items.exampleCN: lectus 是「铺床」义项的拉丁语来源。

items.example: Legere lies behind lectus as a bed of gathered material.
items.exampleCN: legere 是 lectus 的来源，床即由收集来的材料铺成。

items.example: Lit(i)ere carries the Latin word into French.
items.exampleCN: lit(i)ere 把这个拉丁词带入法语。

items.example: Litter keeps the scattering idea in modern use.
items.exampleCN: litter 在现代用法中保留了「散落」的意思。

items.example: The noun turns into a verb with the same image.
items.exampleCN: 名词按同一意象转成动词。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms littering.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 构成 littering。

items.meaning: a person who drops rubbish in public
items.example: Litterbug joins litter with the informal word bug.
items.exampleCN: litterbug 由 litter 与口语词 bug 组合而成。

items.meaning: a person who collects dropped rubbish
items.example: Litter-picker joins litter with picker.
items.exampleCN: litter-picker 由 litter 与 picker 组合而成。

items.example: The suffix -ed forms littered in be littered with.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 在 be littered with 中构成 littered。
